title: Theory on Attention Dynamics for Out-of-Distribution In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36448v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformers have demonstrated remarkable in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, enabling them to perform new tasks without additional fine-tuning. However, their performance often deteriorates when encountering out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs that deviate from the training distribution, and the underlying theory remains poorly understood. To fill this gap, we characterize the OOD error under the input distribution shift through the interplay between the dynamics of the so-called $\alpha$-type and $\beta$-type attention weights, which represent the transformer's confidence in identifying the correct and incorrect features, respectively. Our results indicate that the OOD error for each feature depends on all pairwise interactions between the training features and OOD features, and under certain cases the transformer performs no better than random guessing. translated_title: 分布外上下文学习的注意力动力学理论
translated_abstract: Transformer模型已展现出卓越的上下文学习（ICL）能力，使其无需额外微调即可执行新任务。然而，当遇到偏离训练分布的分布外（OOD）输入时，其性能往往会退化，而其背后的理论仍鲜为人知。为填补这一空白，我们通过所谓的α型和β型注意力权重动力学之间的相互作用来刻画输入分布偏移下的OOD误差，这两种注意力权重分别代表Transformer识别正确特征和错误特征的置信度。我们的结果表明，每个特征的OOD误差取决于训练特征与OOD特征之间的所有两两交互作用，并且在某些情况下，Transformer的表现并不优于随机猜测。为了提升OOD泛化性能，我们进一步研究了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过α型与β型注意力权重的动力学交互刻画了Transformer在分布外输入下的上下文学习误差，证明该误差取决于训练特征与OOD特征之间的所有两两交互作用，且在某些情况下其表现不优于随机猜测。
